newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-April natural rubber imports up 15.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-April natural rubber imports up 15.5 pct.

text.p: China imported 160,000 tonnes of natural rubber and latex in January-April of this year, a rise of 15.5 percent from the same period a year ago, according to customs figures released on Tuesday.
Imports for April alone were 50,000 tonnes, the figures showed.
Imports of natural rubber and latex were 550,000 tonnes in 1996, up 72.1 percent from 1995, earlier official figures show.
China imported 124,291 tonnes of synthetic rubber and latex in the first four months, a year-on-year rise of 9.0 percent, the customs figures showed.
Imports for April alone were 34,918 tonnes.
Synthetic rubber and latex imports in 1996 were 367,456 tonnes, a rise of 17.9 percent compared with the previous year, earlier official figures show.
